investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was used on SRV-WEB-02 to download and execute C:\ProgramData\winupd.ps1 from 91.214.88.109, and a Run registry entry named WindowsUpdateSvc was created to persist that script. The execution used ExecutionPolicy Bypass and a hidden window, and multiple recent events show a download followed by execution of the same script. These behaviors (external download, execution with bypass, and persistence on a server) are consistent with malicious activity and present a high risk to the environment, so further investigation and escalation are warranted.
